scheme_name: Interest Subsidy Scheme for Smaller Business Units
other_conditions: The unit must have its operations in Goa.
The unit can be either new or existing.
The applicant must be one of the following: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership.
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar.
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy on working capital loan up to ₹5,00,000 per annum for a maximum of three years.
